name: Kauzy Stufato
original_name: カウジー＝ストファート
source:
A young guy with a gentle personality who is not very confident in himself. He is indecisive and is often swept away by other people's priorities. [url=/c56366]Saphy[/url], his childhood friend for example has a rotten relationship with him. At first glance he does not look like he minds being her errand boy, though.Kauzy's basically a "good guy" type, so he accepts and fulfills any requests from Saphy.

[Translated from the game's [url=https://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/ps2/angelicconcert/src/angelic_charaframe.htm]Official Homepage[/url].]
